newsitem.title: USA: Dawson files for note, stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Dawson files for note, stock offering.

text.p: Dawson Production Services Inc said on Wednesday it has filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission a registration statement for the public offerings of $110 million of notes and 4.6 million shares of stock.
The senior notes mature 2007 and the stock offering will include 600,000 shares subject to underwriter overallotments, Dawson said.
Also, Dawson said it expects that certain shareholders will sell for their own account additional shares, in an amount not yet determined.

Dawson said net proceeds from the offerings will be used to fund the acquisition of Pride Petroleum Services Inc's domestic onshore well servicing operations, to prepay indebtedness and general corporate purposes.

Pride's domestic land-based fleet consists of 407 workover rigs and related operations in 28 locations in the Texas and Louisiana Gulf Coasts, the Permian Basin areas of West Texas and New Mexico and California.
Upon completion of the acquisition, Dawson will become the largest provider of workover rigs in Texas and the second largest provider in the United States.
Jefferies & Co Inc will be the sole manager of the debt offering and will be the lead manager of the equity offering, with Southcoast Capital Corp acting as a co-manager, Dawson said.
